commitResults.messageTitle: Validate student names and email addresses
commitResults.messageBody:
Align the shared name and email rules with the TeachAssist specification.
Support Unicode names, collapse repeated spaces, and enforce name length
and character constraints. Validate email lengths and domain labels while
preserving local-part case and normalizing the domain to lowercase.

storage tests. Verify with the complete Java 25 Gradle check.

Report specific errors for unknown, repeated, missing, and empty add
parameters before validating field values. Reject embedded line breaks
and preserve repeatable tags and remarks containing numeric slash text.

including tabs, while preserving joined text as parameter values.

filter. Save successfully before publishing records and filter changes
to the live model, and leave read-only commands free of data-file writes.

to preserve existing data when saving fails. Cover failed writes,
temporary-file cleanup, and filtered-index behavior with tests.

is fixed and the application is restarted.

Pass the startup loading result to LogicManager and keep read-only
commands available. Cover missing and corrupt files with startup tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add attendance report for a group on a date
commitResults.messageBody:
Lists the current members of a group in student-list order and marks
each one Present or Absent for the date, with totals. Members without
a matching record are absent, and students who no longer have the
group label are left out even if they have records.

attendance d/YYYY-MM-DD l/GROUP reports on every current group member,
including students hidden by find or filter, and does not save.

LogicManager remembers the report on display. A successful mark
refreshes it after saving, and any other successful command closes
it. A failed command leaves it unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep the active filter unwrapped across data changes
commitResults.messageBody:
LogicManager copied the displayed-list predicate between the pending
and live models with a ::test method reference, adding two wrapper
layers on every data change that keeps the filter. Repeated mark,
unmark, delete or clear under a find filter made filtering steadily
slower and retained every earlier wrapper.

Widen Model#updateFilteredPersonList to accept Predicate<? super Person>,
matching FilteredList, so the predicate is passed through as-is.

Fixes #206

commitResults.messageTitle: Show the remark in the edit success message
commitResults.messageBody:
The edit feedback listed name, Student ID, email and labels but never
the remark, so an edit that only changed the remark gave no sign of the
new value. Append "; Remark: REMARK" when the student has a remark,
matching how add reports a remark, and update the User Guide.

Fixes #208

The edit success message listed labels in HashSet order, which could
change between runs, and the student card sorted them case-sensitively,
putting "Zeta" before "alpha".

Add Label.DISPLAY_ORDER, comparing names ignoring case with Locale.ROOT
as label matching does and breaking ties by exact name, and use it for
both the edit message and the student card.

Fixes #209

commitResults.messageTitle: Show the startup error dialog when the main window fails
commitResults.messageBody:
If constructing MainWindow threw, UiManager's fatal-error handler asked
the still-null mainWindow for its stage, so a NullPointerException
replaced the error dialog and the app exited without telling the user
why. Pass the primary stage, which always exists, as the dialog owner.

Fixes #210

commitResults.messageTitle: Skip undo snapshots for commands that change nothing
commitResults.messageBody:
Every successful data-changing command appended an undo snapshot, even
when it left the records unchanged, such as clear on an empty list or
an edit repeating current values. The next undo then reported
"Undid last change." without changing anything, and hid the earlier
real change behind an extra undo.

Append a snapshot only when the saved address book differs from it,
and document this in the User Guide and Developer Guide.

Fixes #207

commitResults.messageTitle: Test the startup error dialog path
commitResults.messageBody:
The fix for #210 had no test, because a fatal startup error shows a
blocking dialog and then exits the JVM, so codecov/patch reported the
changed lines as uncovered.

Make showAlertDialogAndWait(Stage, ...) and the new exitApplication()
package-private and overridable. UiManagerTest starts the UI with a
logic component whose GUI settings cannot be read, so MainWindow fails
during construction, and checks that the error dialog is owned by the
primary stage and that the application exits. The test needs JavaFX,
so like AttendanceListPanelTest it is skipped where JavaFX cannot
start and runs on CI's virtual display.
